question: What CIDR sizes and how many CIDR blocks can a VPC have for IPv4 and for IPv6?

values.spoken: up to five IPv4 CIDRs, slash sixteen to slash twenty-eight

values.display: Up to 5 CIDRs from /44 to /60 in increments of /4
